reason: It needs my Google account and a seat in our work chat, and I'm not giving a bot I just found either of those. My admin already turns the transfer screenshots into a sheet, so I'm not paying $19 a month to hand my guests' and contractors' payment details to a stranger.
objection: Who is behind @NotaGetBot and what happens to everything it reads in the group? Bank transfers, contractor names, amounts, and whatever else people say in that chat. 'Connect your Google account' is where I stop.
would_change_my_mind: A version that never touches my Google account or sits in the group: I forward only the receipts I choose and get a file back, plus a clear, named company with a written promise that nothing is stored after processing.
